_about: A test description: the project story LicenseWise reads. It never names a license or a
label. 'recovered' is what a second, different model (gpt-oss-20b) found when it read the
story without seeing the profile; it had to match the profile's requirements exactly,
otherwise the description was thrown away ('valid'). 190 of 235 passed. 'gold' is copied

text: We are open-sourcing our internal logging library to build goodwill in the developer
community. It is critical that the license explicitly reserves our company name and brand
assets, so nobody can rebrand this tool as theirs. Additionally, we want to keep the
contribution process simple, meaning contributors should not be obligated to maintain a
detailed changelog of every minor edit they make to the source code.
